# Win-back playbook

*Generated by `python -m fdda.analysis.customers` (full data, snapshot 2020-09-23). Numbers come from `reports/customers/*_full.csv`.*

## Summary

1,362,281 customers were scored on recency, frequency and monetary value. The 4 segments below are the churned or at-risk ones: 546,270 customers (40% of the base) with 113,782,571 indexed revenue at stake (their spend in the year before their last purchase). Offers are capped at the Phase 3 markdown ceiling: **15-25% (max 20% off)**, beyond which deeper discounts cut margin.

## Playbook

| Segment | Customers | Churned (120d) | Revenue at stake | Per customer | Favourite categories | Buys on discount | Responds to | Offer | Action | Channel | Timing | Success KPI |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| **Can't Lose** | 10,196 (1%) | 100% | 12,775,417 | 1,253 | Garment Upper body (42%), Garment Lower body (22%), Garment Full body (11%) | 40% of units | 55%+ | 20% (capped) | Personal re-engagement: early access to the new season plus a capped offer | Email + app push, personalised by favourite category | Now, then 2-3 weeks before each seasonal peak | Reactivation within 60 days vs a 10% holdout; incremental revenue per contact |
| **At Risk** | 131,756 (10%) | 100% | 53,709,365 | 408 | Garment Upper body (41%), Garment Lower body (22%), Garment Full body (10%) | 36% of units | 35-45% | 20% (capped) | 3-touch email series: new arrivals in favourite categories, then the offer | Email (online-heavy segment), store receipt message for in-store buyers | When recency passes 90 days; series over 3 weeks | Second purchase within 45 days vs holdout |
| **Hibernating** | 164,109 (12%) | 100% | 19,870,480 | 121 | Garment Upper body (40%), Garment Lower body (21%), Garment Full body (10%) | 45% of units | 5-15% | 20% | Low-cost content-led nudge; offer only on the last touch | Newsletter / owned channels only (no paid media) | At season launches | Reactivation rate and offer cost per reactivated customer |
| **Lost** | 240,209 (18%) | 100% | 27,427,309 | 114 | Garment Upper body (43%), Garment Lower body (22%), Garment Full body (8%) | 43% of units | 5-15% | 15% | One final reactivation message, then sunset from campaigns | Single email; suppress from paid retargeting | Once, at the next major sale event | Reactivation rate; list hygiene (unsubscribes, bounces) |

* **Revenue at stake** = indexed revenue in the 365 days up to each customer's last purchase: the yearly spend that lapses if they do not come back.
* **Responds to** = the discount band where the segment buys a larger share of its units than the customer base does.
* **Offer** = the segment's median discount when it buys on discount, rounded down to 5%, capped at the Phase 3 ceiling. Run every offer against a holdout group so the KPI measures incremental, not total, reactivation.

## Caveats

* Scores are relative (percentile ranks within this customer base).
* The data ends on the snapshot date, so a long gap may be seasonal rather than permanent churn; the sensitivity table shows how much the window matters.
* Discount behaviour is observational: a segment that bought on discount may have bought anyway. The holdout design in the KPI column is what proves incrementality.
